_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.159 (The Converted profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)
_book_notes: p.159 prices the Converted Epic character 35; the p.178 summary table prints 36. p.133 step 2 takes the profile from the Lifeforms page, so 35 is used

species.description: Cybernetically altered beings driven by a singular purpose. Converted forces are relentless and fearless, advancing without regard for self-preservation.

traits.name: Synthetic
traits.description: The Converted follow the rules for Synthetic beings (see page 146). They can never be veterans.

traits.name: Mindless Assault
traits.description: The Converted do not take Morale tests. They can be Suppressed due to rudimentary survival routines (and occasionally being blasted off their feet). When taking the Dash action, they do not gain any additional movement but may enter close assault combat.
